description:
The Loud Little Parrot: Learning Your Inside Voice! — Polly squawked like a megaphone inside the quiet library! Why was everyone holding their ears, and how did she learn whisper power?
Kids science answer for "inside voices manners for toddlers" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Outside is for shouting, racing, and cheering, but inside cozy rooms, gentle voices protect ears and let everyone think and read peacefully.

BabyBeats Rhymo creates kid-safe 2D science cartoons and funny educational stories every day for curious US kids and families!
